title_zh: 参观农场先问喂食规则

scenario.goal_zh: 确认宠物限制并了解观赏牲畜的位置

context_zh: 游客在农场参观入口向工作人员询问动物的位置和喂食要求。
author: author-phase02-b

sentences.speaker: Rowan
sentences.text: Where can we see the pig? Is it near the sheep?

sentences.speaker: Eve
sentences.text: They are in separate fields. The pig is behind the red barn.

sentences.speaker: Rowan
sentences.text: Can we bring our dog through the gate?

sentences.speaker: Eve
sentences.text: No, pets must stay outside the animal area.

sentences.speaker: Rowan
sentences.text: All right. Can we feed the sheep some leaves from that plant?

sentences.speaker: Eve
sentences.text: Please do not pick anything or feed the animals. You can watch the feeding with a member of staff at two.

sentences.speaker: Rowan
sentences.text: We'll come back for that. For now, we'll just watch from the path.
